_help: The character info window (official MapleStory art, UICharacterInfo.img). x/y = the window top-left in 1366x768 game pixels. w/h = the window size (the art is 472x479). tabX/tabY = the first tab button, tabGap = the pitch between the tabs (the art is 111x20). bodyX/bodyY = the page inside the window (the stats page art is 448x406). nameX/nameY = the name and level spot, window-local. cpX/cpY = the combat power number, the right edge of the number and its top, page-local. The stat rows: each area is two columns (left, right); the column x/w = the hover box, the column vx = the right edge of the number, y/pitch = the first row and the row pitch. The rows per area are fixed by the official label art (3, 8 and 3). main = HP/MP/STR/DEX/INT/LUK, atk = the attack stats, util = mesos and exp. The equip slots: the slot box spot on the official equip page (the icon sits in the middle of the 42x42 box). The item detail box: detailX/detailY/detailW/detailH = the box, window-local; detailIconX/detailIconY/detailIconSize = the item icon in the box; detailNameX/detailNameY = the item name; detailLineX/detailLineY/detailLineGap = the stat lines under the name. DEBUG builds reload this file live on save.
